purpose: Record whether LandIS LEACS data can be downloaded for future MCP-Geo pipe-risk coverage expansion.

conclusion.summary: The public data.gov.uk/CKAN records expose LEACS metadata but only a generic LandIS website HTML resource. The authenticated LandIS ArcGIS portal session was valid, but catalog search and deep service/table field scans found no LEACS, corrosivity, shrink-swell, CORR_FE, CORR_ZN, or SHRINK_SWELL item/table/field. No new LEACS data payload was downloaded.
conclusion.currentPipeRiskCoverage: Only the Warwickshire validation GeoJSON is present locally; Nottinghamshire has zero intersections in landis.pipe_risk_polygons.

futureDecisionRules: Treat LEACS as not available for automated download unless a new protected portal item/table appears, a CKAN package resource changes from HTML to a tabular/spatial format, or Cranfield supplies a licensed extract.

If repeating the check, first compare CKAN resources and protected portal direct search totals against this metadata file. Do not perform a full download unless a new non-HTML resource or matching portal Feature Service/table appears.
If Cranfield supplies an extract, expected useful fields include SHRINK_SWELL, CORR_FE, CORR_ZN, and a join key to soil series, association, or NATMAP map unit.
Until a real LEACS payload exists, any Nottinghamshire pipe-risk expansion should be labelled as a proxy model, not LEACS-derived pipe risk.
